title: Civilization Knowledge Continuity System - Technology Profile
description: Public edition: Preserves essential scientific, manufacturing, agricultural, medical, and engineering capabilities through disruptions.
body:
Civilization Knowledge Continuity System. Preserves essential scientific, manufacturing, agricultural, medical, and engineering capabilities through disruptions.

This database covers the technology as item 214 entry 79 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (A)" catalog, section "Civilizations as Engineered Systems". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: experimentally supported. Continuity planning is real (seed vaults, business continuity); civilization-scale capability preservation is emerging.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Civilization Knowledge Continuity System - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Preserves essential scientific, manufacturing, agricultural, medical, and engineering capabilities through disruptions.
body:
Known science foundations of Civilization Knowledge Continuity System.

The Svalbard seed vault preserves crops. Business continuity plans are standard. The Arctic Code Vault preserves software. Preserving working capabilities — not just seeds and code, but the know-how to rebuild — through disruptions is the frontier.

Key quantity check (Svalbard seed accessions in millions / crop varieties in existence in millions): computed ratio 0.171429 against the reference value, relative error 0.002506, within the stated tolerance of 0.3. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Civilization Knowledge Continuity System - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Preserves essential scientific, manufacturing, agricultural, medical, and engineering capabilities through disruptions.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Civilization Knowledge Continuity System.

Know-how is tacit and hard to preserve. Disruptions are unpredictable. Preserved capabilities need practicing.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 5.85 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is varieties vs capability domains at 5.85 orders of magnitude (varieties larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

title: Civilization Knowledge Continuity System - Unresolved Problems
description: Public edition: Preserves essential scientific, manufacturing, agricultural, medical, and engineering capabilities through disruptions.
body:
Unresolved problems for Civilization Knowledge Continuity System, in priority order (research burden index 33, 3 blocking):

Tacit knowledge (severity 3/3, tractability 1/3, BLOCKING; priority 12).

Covering all capabilities (severity 3/3, tractability 1/3, BLOCKING; priority 12).

Practicing preserved capabilities (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

These are open problems, stated plainly. A technology with unresolved blocking problems is not ready, whatever its promise.
